description.narrative: (Rwanda): Ingobyi refers to a cushion to carry infants or sick people. USAID's Ingobyi activity provides technical assistance at all levels of Rwanda's health system to improve the capacity of health professionals to prevent maternal and child deaths. The activity is focused in 20 of Rwanda's 30 districts. .Ingobyi will train, mentor and supervise doctors, nurses and midwives to improve clinical competencies in antenatal and postnatal care; emergency obstetric and newborn care; management of childhood illnesses; family planning; infection control and prevention; and management of sexual and gender-based violence at the facility level. At the community level, Ingobyi will train and supervise community health workers to correctly diagnose and treat malaria, pneumonia, and diarrhea and to provide reproductive health services. $250,000 of funding within this activity contributes to meeting the required "Gender Based Violence (GBV)" earmark of $250,000..Ingobyi will improve the quality of data captured in the Health Management Information System and its use in decision making. Ingobyi will also support social and behavior change interventions to improve adoption of healthy reproductive, maternal, child, and adolescent behaviors, including hygiene, sanitation, nutrition, and malaria management and control. .Rwanda's pre-service medical system is weak and lacks experienced professionals to provide ongoing clinical mentorship. Ingobyi will continue to partner with the Government of Rwanda and local medical professional associations to provide in-service training to raise the overall clinical competencies of providers in order to build a more professional cadre of medical providers. .... .. ... .
